note: v1 93.72 (seeds 0/11 93.72/93.70), first draft of SOULFUL DEEP HOUSE, 'One More Step', for The Endless Stair - featured illusion THE SPEECH-TO-SONG ILLUSION. A spoken phrase, 'one more step up', repeats every two bars over a warm deep groove (machine-kit, sub, Rhodes on Em9 - Cmaj9 - Am9 - Bm7). At first it is plainly speech, a conversational falling contour; through the second section its contour is pulled, repetition by repetition, onto THE STAIR (E F# G B, the tape's thread) until the sentence sings; a sung double surfaces under it, the break leaves the song alone with a filtered Rhodes, the Rhodes quotes the stair in the last groove, and in the outro the plain speech returns - which by then the ear can only hear as melody. Tempo ramps 118.5 -> 119 inside the track (the mix plan's path); seams drafted with t2 and t4 in mixplan.md. 4:53.
